about: The second 3D action title brought to you by the Animu Game × COSEN team. Guide our princess knight as she races toward the top of the Tower of the Sky, collecting crystals that are said to reveal the whereabouts of the legendary witch. Dive in and enjoy this 3D action-adventure packed with engaging puzzle elements!

Determined to defeat the legendary witch and become a true hero, the princess boards her hot-air balloon and sets foot into the Tower of the Sky. According to ancient lore, gathering the crystals hidden within will unveil the tower's history—and expose the witch's lair. Dismissed by those around her as a troublemaker, this tomboy princess grabs her massive sword and braves a tower crawling with monsters, ready to prove everyone wrong!
summary: The second 3D action title brought to you by the Animu Game × COSEN team.
